items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And our last job we played was in the Earl Theater in Philadelphia with Bill Robinson.

ctx.x: I made arrangements for her and me and Dick Vance and a few others made arrangements. And we took a trip after I got the band in shape because I added on some more men, different things, enlarged the band a little bit. I had three -- instead of the regular three trumpets and two trombones I had three trombones and four trumpets and five saxes. And then we took a trip out West, Grand Terrace and all, went all the way to California and back. And this brought us back to around 1941.
Well, '42, rather. And our last job we played was in the Earl Theater in Philadelphia with Bill Robinson.
